blocks.x: You may offer a four-unit prayer with precise Qunut and other pillars (i.e. genuflection, prostration, and the other parts of prayers). In the first unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah one time and repeat the following verses seventy times:
In the second unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah once and the following verse seven times:
ماشآءَاللّٰهُ لا قُوَّةَ اِلّا بِاللّهِ اِنْ تَرَنِ اَنَا اَقَلَّ مِنْكَ مالاً وَ وَلَداً
In the third unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah once and the following verse seven times:
لا اله الّا انت سبحانك انّى كنت من الظّالمين
In the fourth unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah once and the following verse seven times:
افوّض امرى الى اللّه انّ اللّه بصير بالعباد
You may then mention your need.
